rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with an expanded blastocyst and visible ICM/looser TE, but it overstates certainty from a single image and likely overcalls details such as exact TE discontinuity, polar body/cellular fragment identification, and uniform zona thinning.

Integrates age, BMI, FSH, prior cycle history, sperm parameters, endometrium, and embryo grade well into prognosis, though some links are somewhat speculative (e.g., strong emphasis on low maturity rate as a quality signal).

Reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with a plausible probability estimate tied to embryo and patient factors; minor issues include speculative adjustments and treating prior failures as stronger evidence of RIF than is warranted.

Much is evidence-based, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-supported or are controversial/routine-overreach after only two prior cycles (ERA, EMMA/ALICE, NK testing, thrombophilia/MTHFR panels, assisted hatching, low-dose hCG support, broad PGT-A recommendation in a 28-year-old).

Provides clear next-step suggestions for transfer technique, luteal support considerations, and future stimulation review, but some proposed investigations/interventions may not be the most appropriate or high-yield for this exact case.
